description: A multi-year update of a region's long-range transportation plan: forecasts, scenarios, policies, a financially constrained project list, and the public process that gets it adopted.
scope_notes: This is a standard-practice starting point — edit to your scope. Rename, delete and add records until the list matches the work your agency actually agreed to do.

Every date is calculated forward from the kickoff date you enter. The offsets are round numbers reflecting how this kind of work is usually sequenced — they are placeholders for a real schedule, not commitments.
This is a long update — roughly two and a half years from kickoff to adoption. Regions that update on a shorter cycle should compress the offsets rather than delete the steps.
The financial element and the project lists are the parts most tightly governed by whoever funds the plan. Nothing here states what your funder requires; confirm it and add the records it implies.

No jurisdiction is assumed. Review periods, required notices, hearings and the body that adopts the work are set where you are; none of them are stated here. Add the records your own process requires.
Nobody is assigned. Applying a template never puts a colleague's name on a deadline — assign the records yourself once the team is settled.

deliverables.title: Work plan and public participation plan
deliverables.summary: The schedule for the update and the written commitment on how the public and partner agencies will be involved.

deliverables.title: Regional baseline conditions report
deliverables.summary: Travel, land use, demographics, safety and system condition as they stand at the start of the update.

deliverables.title: Growth forecasts and travel model results
deliverables.summary: The demographic and travel forecasts the plan rests on, with the assumptions and the model's limitations stated.

deliverables.title: Scenario analysis report
deliverables.summary: How the region performs under alternative growth and investment patterns, measured against the plan's own performance measures.

deliverables.title: Preferred scenario and policy framework
deliverables.summary: The direction chosen, and the policies that follow from it.

deliverables.title: Financial element
deliverables.summary: Revenue assumptions and the demonstration that the plan's costs stay inside them, with every assumption sourced.

deliverables.title: Short-term and long-term project lists
deliverables.summary: The programmed and planned projects with their costs, funding sources and horizon periods.

deliverables.title: Public review draft plan
deliverables.summary: The complete document assembled for public review.

deliverables.title: Final plan document
deliverables.summary: The draft revised in response to comments, with the comment-response record attached.

milestones.title: Update kickoff
milestones.summary: Scope, schedule, committee structure and the participation plan confirmed.

milestones.title: Regional scenario workshops
milestones.summary: The public and member agencies weigh the alternatives while the preferred direction is still open.

milestones.title: Public review draft released
milestones.summary: The draft plan and its supporting analysis are published for comment.

milestones.title: Public hearings on the draft plan
milestones.summary: The formal hearings held before adoption.

milestones.title: Adoption of the updated plan
milestones.summary: Adoption by the region's governing board.
